title: An affine coherent algebra realization with proper support is finite and proper
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], f : X -> S locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and g : Y -> X affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let B be a commutative O_X-algebra sheaf [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf] with an O_X-algebra isomorphism B -> g_*O_Y. If the underlying module of B is coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then g is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and g followed by f is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism].

source.place: Lemma 09ZT, last sentence, finite and properness clauses; Lemma 0CYS (3)

proof.text: The underlying module is quasi-coherent of finite type by coherence on the locally Noetherian X. On every affine U its sections B(U) are a finite O_X(U)-module. The algebra isomorphism to g_*O_Y and the affine chart identify g inverse U with Spec B(U). Hence g is finite by the affine definition.

Proper support supplies a closed immersion i : Z -> X with i followed by f proper and i.ker annihilating B. On U = Spec R, with J defining Z, the projection Y times_X Z -> Y is Spec of B(U) -> B(U)/J B(U), which is an isomorphism since J kills B(U). These identifications show the projection is an isomorphism globally. The base change Y times_X Z -> Z is finite, hence its composite to S is proper. Transport properness along the projection to obtain IsProper(g followed by f).
